scope_boundary.purpose: Isolated VM load test of the locally signed WaveRT adapter package using official Windows 11 Enterprise Evaluation media.
not_claimed: Microsoft signing or consumer release readiness

vm_configuration: Secure Boot disabled for local test-signing evaluation

steps.command: DISM /Apply-Image to a fresh VHDX; bcdboot EFI repair
steps.result: Windows booted successfully in the isolated VM.

steps.command: bcdedit /set testsigning yes (offline BCD then in-guest verification)

steps.result: FAILED with store-not-found; Driver Store consequently rejected the catalog with 0xE0000242 and reported an untrusted publisher.
steps.diagnostic: setupapi.dev.log recorded catalog validation, root trust, then publisher-trust failure.

steps.command: Import-Certificate into LocalMachine TrustedPublisher followed by pnputil /add-driver ... /install
steps.result: TrustedPublisher certificate imported; driver package staged successfully as oem2.inf.
steps.diagnostic: pnputil exit code 0. This command stages the package but does not create a Root-enumerated device.

steps.result: Root device node created; service installed; drivers copied from Driver Store.
steps.diagnostic: Device entered CM_PROB_FAILED_START with problem status 0xC000000D after PnP start.

steps.result: Failure remained reproducible, confirming this was not transient boot state.

final_state.interpretation: Package installation and signature trust are proven; runtime adapter start is not yet successful.

claims: Anonymous VM provisioning, test-signing configuration, package staging, publisher-trust recovery and reproducible failed-start evidence only. No endpoint/audio behavior, physical-device, HLK or release claim.
next_safe_action: Diagnose the PortCls adapter start path against the existing WDK descriptor fixes before another guest installation attempt.
